_: Type styles the renderer uses, hand-maintained: Tailwind sizes by call-site count plus the classes in globals.css. build.mjs copies these in; families and fonts come from the code.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: The app's working size: buttons, inputs, badges, menu items, card titles, toast titles. The most-used size in the renderer (268 call sites).

styles.name: text-11
styles.usage: Dense table cells and metadata (`text-[11px]`, 212 call sites); the strong section label and toast action button at 600.

styles.name: text-10
styles.usage: Toast descriptions, menu subtitles and shortcut hints (`text-[10px]`, 141 call sites).

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Dialog titles (600), descriptions, form labels, the lg Button, tab triggers (500).
styles.sample: Export this case as a Case Archive

styles.name: text-2xl
styles.usage: Metric values and the dashboard hero.

styles.name: text-4xl
styles.usage: The one display size: the dashboard hero title.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: The eyebrow every panel head uses, in uppercase and `color-text-faint`. An eyebrow, not a heading.

styles.name: section-label-strong
styles.usage: The 11px step for heads that carry more weight, in uppercase and `color-text-secondary`. A modifier of `section-label`.

styles.name: note-body
styles.usage: `.note-prose` paragraphs in `color-text-secondary`, identical in the editor and read-only note bodies.
styles.sample: The page was captured twice; the second shows the edited headline.

styles.name: mention-chip
styles.usage: `.mention-chip`: an inline entity reference, 1px 6px padding, 5px radius, coloured by the entity's own `--mention-color` at 14% fill and a 28% ring.

styles.name: badge-mono
styles.usage: The `sm` Badge (the default size) sets its label in mono: hashes, counts, method names.

styles.name: shortcut
styles.usage: ContextMenuShortcut in `color-text-faint`. Only real routes, never a claim.
